assumptions: Under 10,000 API requests/month total (~3K writes, ~7K reads).
Static frontend is under 100 MB (HTML/CSS/JS, no media uploads).
No authentication required for this portfolio prototype.
us-east-1 chosen for lowest cost and renewable energy commitments.
DynamoDB on-demand mode — no provisioned capacity.
TTL set to 90 days to auto-delete old reports (sustainability: data patterns).
CloudWatch Logs retention set to 14 days (automatic with Lambda, no extra resource needed).
Route 53 hosted zone ($0.50/month) and ACM certificate (free) are needed only if using a custom domain — noted in deployment steps.
Lambda memory at 256 MB — can be reduced to 128 MB after measuring actual usage in CloudWatch.

connections.description: CloudFront fetches static assets from S3 via Origin Access Control (OAC). Bucket stays private.
PutItem to write a new waste report with UUID, timestamp, and TTL.
Query by area-index or status-index to return reports sorted newest-first.

name: Community Waste Reporting App

resources.name: Frontend Bucket
resources.purpose: Hosts static HTML/CSS/JS for the reporting dashboard. Private bucket accessed only via CloudFront OAC.

resources.name: CloudFront Distribution
resources.purpose: Edge-caches the frontend for low latency and serves it over HTTPS via ACM. Reduces S3 origin fetches.

resources.name: Reports HTTP API
resources.purpose: HTTP API (not REST — 70% cheaper) routing POST /reports and GET /reports to Lambda functions. Built-in CORS support.

resources.name: SubmitReport Function
resources.purpose: Validates input and writes a new waste report to DynamoDB. Sets reportId (UUID), createdAt, and expiresAt (TTL = 90 days).

resources.name: GetReports Function
resources.purpose: Queries DynamoDB by area (GSI) or status (GSI) and returns reports sorted by createdAt descending.

resources.name: WasteReports Table
resources.purpose: Stores waste reports. PK=reportId. GSI area-index (PK=area, SK=createdAt) and status-index (PK=status, SK=createdAt). TTL on expiresAt auto-deletes reports after 90 days.

summary: Serverless waste reporting system: S3+CloudFront static frontend, HTTP API Gateway routing to ARM64 Lambda functions, DynamoDB on-demand for storage. Scale-to-zero, Free Tier eligible, sustainability-aligned.
